test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pointing to a woman in a picture, Taran said, “She is the mother of the father-in-law of my husband”. How is Taran related to that woman?
solution:
We draw a diagram according to the table, to get the answer:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/490ce14817c8963d2ee018f5e7bab329d6eb0fe58f06f4b48d5460a534109943.png] 

From the given information, we get:

 
• Father-in-law of my husband = My father
 
• Mother of the father-in-law of my husband = Mother of my father

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf951398e7c3c810643975bbada099960bde2762971e918e5c0d51856fff7689.png] 

Mother of Taran's father = Grandmother of Taran

Hence, **the correct answer is Granddaughter.**
